name: native
description: Sutra Native v1.4.0 — STANDALONE runtime-active founder workflow engine for Claude Code. v1.4.0 (2026-05-06, D49) makes Native fully standalone — no core@sutra dependency at runtime. Native ships its own H-Sutra producer hook (hooks/per-turn-h-sutra.sh) + vendored classifier (scripts/classify.sh) + shared lib (lib/h-sutra-classify-and-write.sh, sync'd from canonical at sutra/marketplace/plugin/lib/). Co-installed with core@sutra: arbitration intrinsic to lib (first producer wins per-turn lock). Single env break-glass SUTRA_HSUTRA_FORCE_DISABLE=1 (loud-logged); no file toggles. Codex round-1..5 design review folds applied (threads 019dfc31..019dfc52). + v1.3.0 (2026-05-04) shipped W1-W6: W1 per-step timeout_ms + invoke_host_llm CLI + create-trigger CLI; W2 approval-gate primitive (3 events + step.requires_approval + resumeApproved); W3 workflow status/cancel + tenant list; W4 on_failure pause/rollback/escalate; W5 PNC predicate parser + commitment_broken event; W6 cutover validate + dry-run. + v1.2.x (2026-05-04) host-LLM wire (LiteExecutor.invoke_host_llm dispatches via hostLLMActivity claude --bare / codex exec) + Asawa replica via Native primitives ($HOME/.sutra-native-asawa-replica/, 21D+8C+6W+6T). SessionStart hook auto-activates the engine; founder input flows UserPromptSubmit hook (Native's own per-turn-h-sutra.sh OR core's per-turn-discipline-prompt.sh — arbitrated) → H-Sutra log → HSutraConnector → Router (deterministic + optional LLM fallback) → LiteExecutor (step_graph runner) → RendererRegistry (8 default terminal renderers) → SUCCESS Execution. Ships compiled dist/ + bin/sutra-native CLI + library exports (@sutra/native main/exports/types) + D3 starter kit + 1207 contract+integration tests + SBOMs. Standalone install: native@sutra alone produces JSONL + tails it; no core@sutra required.
